test_title: PYST 78: SSC GD Constable - GA & GK (Held On - 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: gk
question: The Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner comes under which of the following ministries of Government of India

options.text: Ministry of Statistics and Program Implementation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The responsibility of conducting the decennial Census rests with the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The Census Act was enacted in 1948 to provide for the scheme of conducting population census with the duties and responsibilities of census officers.
 
• Current Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India- Dr Vivek Joshi
 
• 1872 - The first census was conducted in India non-synchronously in different parts.
 
• The Census Organization of India- a family of 33 Nos. Directorate of Census Operations working under the aegis of its Headquarter - Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Population data are collected through a Census operation held every 10 years in our country.
 
• The first population Census in India was conducted in 1872
 
• 1872 - The first census was conducted in India non-synchronously in different parts.
 
• The first complete Census was conducted only in 1881.
 
• Theme of Census 2021- Janganana se Jan Kalyan
 
• Theme of Census 2011 - Our Census, Our future
